evidence: E3M4 s42, s63, s65 (bays) and s41, s64, s66 (dividers); knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_e3m4_ward_bays.py lists all 24 and 23
knowledge/blood/references/room-grammar.json per_map E3M4 corridors (tools/mine_room_grammar.py): 74, width median 512, p90 1,024
use: Build a dormitory, cell row or ward as repeated small bay sectors.
